claims.text: Waymo's October 14th post says anyone in San Antonio can now download the app and hail a fully autonomous ride, including the San Antonio International Airport.
claims.quote: Starting today, anyone in San Antonio, San Diego, and Tampa can download the Waymo app and hail a fully autonomous ride, including the San Antonio International Airport.

claims.text: Texas Public Radio reports Waymo began operating in San Antonio in February in a limited service area covering 60 square miles.
claims.quote: Waymo began operations in San Antonio in February in a limited service area covering 60 square miles of the city.
claims.scope_note: Press report. Waymo's February post says first public riders were welcomed in San Antonio that day.

claims.text: Texas Public Radio reports a Waymo vehicle was swept up in flood waters and washed into Salado Creek during heavy rain on April 20th.
claims.quote: The Waymo vehicle was swept up in flood waters and washed into Salado Creek during heavy rains on April 20.
claims.scope_note: Press report of the April 20th incident.

claims.text: Texas Public Radio reports the car was unoccupied and no one was injured.
claims.quote: The car was unoccupied and no one was injured in the incident.

claims.text: Texas Public Radio reports that earlier in April another Waymo vehicle became stranded in floodwaters, and that both cars were unoccupied and no one was injured in either incident.
claims.quote: In an earlier incident that occurred earlier in April, another Waymo vehicle became stranded in floodwaters near McCullough Avenue and Contour Drive. Both cars were unoccupied, and no one was injured in either incident.
claims.scope_note: Press report. The same article places the earlier incident near McCullough Avenue and Contour Drive.

claims.text: The federal recall record lists 3,791 potentially affected units.
claims.scope_note: Record Summary: Waymo LLC (Waymo) is recalling certain 5th and 6th Generation Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The raw value carries no thousands separator. Texas Public Radio reports nearly 3,800 vehicles.

claims.text: The federal recall record says the software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways.
claims.quote: The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways.

claims.text: The federal recall record says the remedy is currently under development.
claims.quote: The remedy is currently under development.
claims.scope_note: NHTSA campaign 26E026 remedy field, read on October 19th, 2026.

claims.text: The federal recall record says that as an interim remedy Waymo modified the scope of vehicle operations to increase weather-related constraints and updated the vehicle maps.
claims.quote: As an interim remedy, Waymo modified the scope of vehicle operations to increase weather-related constraints and updated the vehicle maps.
claims.scope_note: NHTSA campaign 26E026 remedy field. The record does not say what the constraints are.

claims.text: The federal recall record says entering a flooded roadway can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.
claims.quote: Entering a flooded roadway can cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash or injury.

claims.text: Texas Public Radio reports the recall notice said that while the vehicle detected the flooded road, it continued on its path and proceeded at a reduced speed.
claims.quote: The recall notice said while the vehicle detected the flooded road, it continued on its path and proceeded at a reduced speed.
claims.scope_note: Press report of the recall notice. The notice itself was not retrieved.

claims.text: The federal recall record says all affected vehicles received the interim update by April 20th, 2026.
claims.quote: All affected vehicles received the interim update by April 20, 2026.
claims.scope_note: NHTSA campaign 26E026 remedy field. The record doesn't say whether the interim limits are in force now.

claims.text: Texas Public Radio reports the company recalled nearly 3,800 fifth- and sixth-generation vehicles.
claims.quote: The company issued the recall of nearly 3,800 fifth- and sixth-generation vehicles to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
claims.scope_note: Press report of the recall size. The federal record lists 3,791 potentially affected units.
